front: When should IV contrast be used for LV opacification?
back: When ≥ 2 of 6 basal or mid LV segments are poorly visualized on standard imaging (per ASE guidelines).

front: First-line echo modality for suspected LAA thrombus prior to cardioversion?
back: TEE. TTE cannot reliably visualize the LAA.

front: When is handheld / point-of-care echo (POCUS) appropriate?
back: Bedside triage of pericardial effusion, gross LV function, and IVC assessment. Not a substitute for a comprehensive study.
